_comment: Single source of truth for research-source credential injection. Consumed by both the Python cloud runner (qlix/research_sources.py -> cloud_research_runtime.configure_research_sources) and the backend provisioner (backend/src/cloudRunners/platformResearchSecrets.ts). Add a new source by appending one entry here + installing its CLI in sdk/python/docker/cloud-runner/Dockerfile. Credentials are platform-wide (Qlix ops): host files live in the research secrets dir, env vars are forwarded from the backend process env.

sources.auth_failed_hint: Twitter search failed — set AGENT_REACH_TWITTER_AUTH_TOKEN and AGENT_REACH_TWITTER_CT0 on the runner.
Reddit search failed — refresh secrets/reddit-credential.json (run `rdt login` on a workstation, then copy ~/.config/rdt-cli/credential.json).
sources.blocked_hint: Reddit requires login (rdt-cli or opencli) — add secrets/reddit-credential.json to the runner.

sources.auth_failed_hint: Xiaohongshu search failed — refresh secrets/xiaohongshu-cookies.json (QR-login once via xiaohongshu-mcp, then copy ~/.xhs-mcp/cookies.json).
sources.blocked_hint: Xiaohongshu requires login — add secrets/xiaohongshu-cookies.json to the runner.
